note: Addressed on behalf of Imam Zayn al-ʿĀbidīn, taken captive after Karbalāʾ (v6). Repeat the chorus after each verse.

verses.en: O my master, have mercy on us.

verses.ar: إِنْ تَلْتِ يَا رِيحَ الصَّبَا يَوْمًا إِلَى أَرْضِ الْحَرَمِ ۞ بَلِّغْ سَلَامِي رَوْضَةً فِيهَا النَّبِيُّ الْمُحْتَرَمْ (2)
verses.tr: Inaltiya riha-saba yawman ilā arḍi-l-ḥaram ۞ balligh salāmī rawḍatan fīhā-n-Nabiyyu-l-muḥtaram (2)
verses.en: If, O east wind, you should one day pass by the sacred land, carry my greeting to the garden where the honoured Prophet rests.

verses.ar: مَنْ وَجْهُهُ شَمْسُ الضُّحَى مَنْ خَدُّهُ بَدْرُ الدُّجَى ۞ مَنْ ذَاتُهُ نُورُ الْهُدَى مَنْ كَفُّهُ بَحْرُ الْهِمَمْ (2)
verses.tr: Man wajhuhu shamsu-ḍ-ḍuḥā man khadduhu badru-d-dujā ۞ man dhātuhu nūru-l-hudā man kaffuhu baḥru-l-himam (2)
verses.en: He whose face is the forenoon sun, whose cheek is the full moon at nightfall; whose very being is the light of guidance, whose open hand is an ocean of generosity.

verses.ar: قُرْآنُهُ بُرْهَانُنَا فَسْخًا لِأَدْيَانٍ مَضَتْ ۞ إِذْ جَاءَنَا أَحْكَامُهُ كُلُّ الصُّحُفِ صَارَ الْعَدَمْ (2)
verses.tr: Qurʾānuhu burhānunā faskhan li-adyānin maḍat ۞ idh jāʾanā aḥkāmuhu kullu-ṣ-ṣuḥufi ṣāra-l-ʿadam (2)
verses.en: His Qur'an is our proof, an abrogation of every religion now passed away; since his rulings came to us, every other scripture became as nothing.

verses.ar: أَكْبَادُنَا مَجْرُوحَةٌ مِنْ سَيْفِ هِجْرِ الْمُصْطَفَى ۞ طُوبَى لِأَهْلِ بَلْدَةٍ فِيهَا النَّبِيُّ الْمُحْتَشَمْ (2)
verses.tr: Akbādunā majrūḥatun min sayfi hijri-l-Muṣṭafā ۞ ṭūbā li-ahli baldatin fīhā-n-Nabiyyu-l-muḥtasham (2)
verses.en: Our hearts are wounded by the sword of separation from the Chosen One; blessed are the people of a town in which the honoured Prophet dwells.

verses.ar: يَا رَحْمَةً لِلْعَالَمِينَ أَنْتَ شَفِيعُ الْمُذْنِبِينَ ۞ أَكْرِمْ لَنَا يَوْمَ الْحَزِينِ فَضْلًا وَجُودًا وَالْكَرَمْ (2)
verses.tr: Yā raḥmatan li-l-ʿālamīn anta shafīʿu-l-mudhnibīn ۞ akrim lanā yawma-l-ḥazīni faḍlan wa jūdan wa-l-karam (2)
verses.en: O mercy for all the worlds, you are the intercessor of sinners — be generous to us on the day of grief, with bounty, munificence and honour.

verses.ar: يَا رَحْمَةً لِلْعَالَمِينَ أَدْرِكْ لِزَيْنِ الْعَابِدِينَ ۞ مَحْبُوسَ أَيْدِي الظَّالِمِينَ فِي الْمَوْكِبِ وَالْمُزْدَحَمْ (2)
verses.tr: Yā raḥmatan li-l-ʿālamīn adrik li-Zayni-l-ʿĀbidīn ۞ maḥbūsa aydi-ẓ-ẓālimīna fi-l-mawkibi wa-l-muzdaḥam (2)
verses.en: O mercy for all the worlds, come to the aid of Zayn al-ʿAbidin, held captive in the hands of the oppressors, amid the crowded procession.
